MY APPROACH

People, process and evidence.

I am platform agnostic in how I diagnose recruiting operations. I start with the hiring process, the people using it and the decisions the data needs to support. Then I work within the customer’s platform to improve workflows, reporting and adoption.

01 / LISTEN

Agree the real question

What outcome matters to the Head of Talent? Where are recruiters and hiring managers getting stuck? What can the team actually change?

02 / TEST

Check the evidence

Look at definitions, missing records and different role groups before attributing a cause. Make uncertainty visible.

03 / ENABLE

Teach the team

Explain why a measure matters, give the CSM and recruiting team routine checks they can own, and reserve specialist time for complex questions.

04 / DELIVER

Agree the next step

Scope a manageable pilot with owners, acceptance criteria, boundaries and a review date. Bring reproducible product feedback to the right team.
